title: Slice and Partition Rank Criteria for Polynomial Zero-Avoidance
summary: We study polynomial zero-avoidance over finite vector spaces by means of slice rank and partition rank. We first make the support-entropy method effective by showing how a finite dual certificate yields an explicit entropy gap whenever the coefficient support admits no probability distribution with uniform marginals.
